# Notebook 20 -- Calibrate GR4J per catchment

**What this notebook does.** For every prepared catchment (Tier 1/2):

1. Builds an airGR `InputsModel` from the daily table produced by HYD_10
   (precipitation in mm/day, PET in mm/day).
2. Runs **GR4J** over the full 1981-2014 period with a 1-year warm-up, and
   calibrates the 4 parameters on the **calibration window**
   `r format(hyd_calib_start)` .. `r format(hyd_calib_end)` with
   `Calibration_Michel` (local-search optimisation of KGE in mm/day).
3. Evaluates **out-of-sample** on the validation window
   `r format(hyd_valid_start)` .. `r format(hyd_valid_end)`: KGE, NSE and
   PBIAS (PBIAS computed manually -- airGR has no such criterion).
4. Saves parameters (`params/<id>.rds`) and a diagnostics table
   (`hyd_calib_summary.csv`).

Discharge stays in model space (mm/day) throughout; convert with
`Q[m3/s] = Q[mm/d] * Area[km2] / 86.4` when presenting results.

```{r log-file}
hyd_log_file <- file.path(hyd_output_dir, "hyd_20_log.txt")
dir.create(file.path(hyd_output_dir, "params"), showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## 1. Roster (only catchments with prepared inputs)

```{r roster}
roster <- data.table::fread(file.path(hyd_output_dir, "hyd_inputs_summary.csv"),
                            colClasses = list(character = "id"))
if (hyd_test_mode) roster <- roster[id %in% hyd_test_ids]
cat("Catchments to calibrate:", nrow(roster), "\n")
```

## 2. Calibrate + validate

```{r calibrate}
idx <- function(d) which(full_dates >= d & full_dates <= d)
full_dates <- seq(hyd_period_start, hyd_period_end, by = "day")

# Warm-up = first `hyd_warmup_days` days of the full series (1981); the run
# starts the day after. NOTE: airGR silently ignores a warm-up that overlaps
# the run window, so IndPeriod_Run must start AFTER the warm-up indices.
i_warm     <- seq(1L, hyd_warmup_days)                       # 1981-01-01 .. 1981-12-31
i_run_cal  <- seq(1L, idx(hyd_calib_end))[-i_warm]           # 1982-01-01 .. 2000-12-31
i_run_full <- seq(1L, idx(hyd_period_end))[-i_warm]          # 1982-01-01 .. 2014-12-31
i_val      <- idx(hyd_valid_start):idx(hyd_valid_end)        # 2001-01-01 .. 2014-12-31

calib_opts <- airGR::CreateCalibOptions(FUN_MOD = airGR::RunModel_GR4J)

calib_rows <- list(); n_row <- 0L

for (i in seq_len(nrow(roster))) {
   id <- roster$id[i]
   res <- tryCatch({
      dt <- data.table::fread(file.path(hyd_inputs_dir, paste0(id, "_obs.csv")))

      # calibration needs observed Q inside the calibration run window
      if (sum(!is.na(dt$Qobs_mm[i_run_cal])) < 3650) {
         calib_rows[[n_row <- n_row + 1L]] <- data.frame(
            id, status = "skipped_less_than_3650_valid_Q_in_calib")
         next
      }

      inputs <- airGR::CreateInputsModel(
         FUN_MOD = airGR::RunModel_GR4J,
         DatesR  = as.POSIXct(dt$date),
         Precip  = dt$P_mm,
         PotEvap = dt$PET_mm)

      # 1) calibration run window = calibration years ONLY (no data leakage)
      run_opt_calib <- airGR::CreateRunOptions(
         FUN_MOD          = airGR::RunModel_GR4J,
         InputsModel      = inputs,
         IndPeriod_WarmUp = i_warm,
         IndPeriod_Run    = i_run_cal)

      crit_calib <- airGR::CreateInputsCrit(
         FUN_CRIT     = airGR::ErrorCrit_KGE,
         InputsModel  = inputs,
         RunOptions   = run_opt_calib,
         VarObs       = "Q",
         Obs          = dt$Qobs_mm[i_run_cal])

      calib <- airGR::Calibration_Michel(inputs, run_opt_calib, crit_calib,
                                         calib_opts,
                                         FUN_MOD = airGR::RunModel_GR4J,
                                         FUN_CRIT = airGR::ErrorCrit_KGE)

      # 2) evaluation run = continuous 1982-2014 with the calibrated params
      run_opt_full <- airGR::CreateRunOptions(
         FUN_MOD          = airGR::RunModel_GR4J,
         InputsModel      = inputs,
         IndPeriod_WarmUp = i_warm,
         IndPeriod_Run    = i_run_full)

      outputs <- airGR::RunModel(inputs, run_opt_full,
                                 Param = calib$ParamFinalR,
                                 FUN_MOD = airGR::RunModel_GR4J)

      sim_mm <- outputs$Qsim
      # Qsim is indexed within the run window (starts after the warm-up), so
      # simulation indices = calendar indices - warm-up length
      o_cal  <- dt$Qobs_mm[i_run_cal]
      s_cal  <- sim_mm[i_run_cal - hyd_warmup_days]
      o_val  <- dt$Qobs_mm[i_val]
      s_val  <- sim_mm[i_val - hyd_warmup_days]

      kge_calc <- function(o, s) {
         keep <- !is.na(o) & !is.na(s)
         o <- o[keep]; s <- s[keep]
         if (length(o) < 365 || sd(o) == 0) return(NA_real_)
         r <- cor(o, s)
         alpha <- sd(s) / sd(o)
         beta  <- mean(s) / mean(o)
         1 - sqrt((r - 1)^2 + (alpha - 1)^2 + (beta - 1)^2)
      }
      nse_calc <- function(o, s) {
         keep <- !is.na(o) & !is.na(s)
         o <- o[keep]; s <- s[keep]
         1 - sum((s - o)^2) / sum((o - mean(o))^2)
      }
      pbias_calc <- function(o, s) {
         keep <- !is.na(o) & !is.na(s)
         100 * (sum(s[keep] - o[keep]) / sum(o[keep]))
      }

      calib_rows[[n_row <- n_row + 1L]] <- data.frame(
         id, status = "calibrated",
         kge_calib = round(kge_calc(o_cal, s_cal), 3),
         nse_calib = round(nse_calc(o_cal, s_cal), 3),
         kge_valid = round(kge_calc(o_val, s_val), 3),
         nse_valid = round(nse_calc(o_val, s_val), 3),
         pbias_valid = round(pbias_calc(o_val, s_val), 2),
         param_x1 = round(calib$ParamFinalR[1], 1),
         param_x2 = round(calib$ParamFinalR[2], 1),
         param_x3 = round(calib$ParamFinalR[3], 2),
         param_x4 = round(calib$ParamFinalR[4], 3))
      saveRDS(list(id = id, param = calib$ParamFinalR, area_km2 = roster$area_km2[i]),
              file.path(hyd_output_dir, "params", paste0(id, ".rds")))
      "ok"
   }, error = function(e) {
      hyd_log(paste("ERROR", id, conditionMessage(e)), hyd_log_file)
      paste("error:", conditionMessage(e))
   })
}

hyd_calib_summary <- data.table::rbindlist(calib_rows, fill = TRUE)
data.table::fwrite(hyd_calib_summary,
                   file.path(hyd_output_dir, "hyd_calib_summary.csv"))
print(table(hyd_calib_summary$status))
print(summary(hyd_calib_summary$kge_valid))
hyd_log(paste0("HYD_20 done: ", sum(hyd_calib_summary$status == "calibrated"),
               " calibrated"), hyd_log_file)
```

## 3. Interpretation guide

- `kge_valid` is the headline number: performance on years the model never saw
  during calibration.
- GR4J parameters (airGR units): X1 = production store capacity (mm),
  X2 = inter-catchment exchange coefficient (mm/day), X3 = routing store
  capacity (mm), X4 = unit hydrograph time base (days).
- Per your manuscript, median out-of-sample KGE around 0.6 for Indian
  catchments is expected; individual catchments will vary widely.
